snippet.title: 10 Year Anniversary Special Announcement
snippet.description:
Animation by Kiwikelly

A sequel to Pokémon Infinite Fusion is currently in development! This new game will take you to the Hoenn region for an entirely new journey! You will  also be able to transfer any Pokémon between the two games. You can find more information in this FAQ.

https://docs.google.com/document/d/1BkCbkhgJ3_HEFp7Znx3N3WeOQCzqcRnRn-qZ0lhsHW0/edit?usp=sharing

This also means that all missing Pokémon from the Hoenn Pokédex will be added to both Pokémon Infinite Fusion and Pokémon Infinite Fusion: Hoenn! The full list of new Pokémon added and their Pokédex numbers can be found in the FAQ
